dedupe_keys.name: field measurements of dune erosion and hydrodynamics during the hybrid dune experiment

description: Field measurements of dune erosion and hydrodynamics during the Hybrid Dune experiment is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Daan W. Poppema et al. Hybrid flood defences combine sandy dunes with hard coastal structures such as dikes or dams. The Hybrid Dune experiment investigated hydro-morphodynamic interactions between dunes and hard structures during storm events in the collision regime. Coverage: not stated; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in 4TU.ResearchData and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
